target_customer: B2B sales teams, especially industrial and energy sellers, running outbound
problem: Outbound sequences are generic. Meticulate encodes a team's sales rules and combines them with prospect research and buying signals to generate individual outreach.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription: about 950 USD per month for founder led sales with 2 seats, from 18,000 USD per year for AE and BDR teams (company site)
product_category: AI prospecting and outbound sales platform

founders.name: Wilbur Li
founders.background_notes: YC page: commercial strategy and sales operations in the energy industry; serves in the Army Reserves.

founders.name: Joseph Palakapilly
founders.background_notes: YC page: research on speech recognition and NLP at Rev; controls for megawatt scale solar and storage at Camus.

technical_complexity.rationale: Research agents plus message generation and CRM sync were standard LLM engineering in early 2024; signal monitoring adds integration work.

defensibility.rationale: Many AI outbound tools (Clay, Regie.ai, 11x, Apollo according to 2025 and 2026 vendor pages) offer similar personalization, so a prompt and data workflow is copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Sales platforms and well funded AI SDR startups were building the same wedge; no acquisition of Meticulate was found.

market_need_then: Sales teams were already paying for outbound tooling, and the company's customer list on the YC page names OpenAI, Noda and ThreeKit as users, though the demand figures are company claims.

branding.domain_note: Uses meticulate.ai; no purchase history found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Bold and direct, with headlines like Radically improve your sales outreach and quantified claims such as a 380 percent conversion lift (company claim).

brand_strength.rationale: Name is easily confused with Meticulous, an unrelated company that appears in search results; no independent brand coverage was found.

outcome_analysis: Meticulate is an active five person company selling AI outbound tooling to industrial sellers, with named customers including OpenAI. Public funding data is limited to aggregator listings of a small YC check, so the trajectory beyond the batch is unknown. The category is crowded and consolidating, which is the main risk.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators list 500K USD from YC (convertible note or pre-seed, early 2024 or April 2024); the YC page lists Y Combinator, Link and Cervin Ventures as backers without amounts, and another aggregator lists Leonis Capital and E14 Fund. No press confirmation, so no round recorded. Results about Meticulous are a different company. Competitor results were 2025 and 2026 vendor pages, so none are recorded as of founding. Outcome search found no acquisition, shutdown or layoffs. Completeness pass: the 500K pre-seed rests on databases only (FundedIQ dates it 2024-04; CB Insights shows a 0.5M convertible note dated 2024-01-01, probably the same money). Link Ventures lists Meticulate in its portfolio. Not summed.
